CLIMATE CONTROL

What the hallway holds

HALL 68–78°F · RH ≤ 55%

Indoor hallways are held between 68 and 78 degrees, with humidity kept under 55 percent. Wood, fabric, paper and leather stay where you left them.

If a hallway log shows humidity over 55% for a day, we move you to another unit at no cost. Sample label

Sealed roller-shutter detail evokes a controlled envelope.

No yearly contract. Give notice before your next due date and you are done. Rent is due on the first. Late fees and lien process are spelled out in the agreement you sign.
